text: SEIR保存則と初期線形化 SEIR conservation and initial linearization SEIR保存則と初期線形化 \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-\beta SI,&\dot E&=\beta SI-\sigma E,\\\dot I&=\sigma E-\gamma I,&\dot R&=\gamma I.\end{aligned};\quad \beta=0.6,\quad\sigma=0.3,\quad\gamma=0.2,\quad(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1-2\eta,\eta,\eta,0);\quad S+E+I+R=1,\quad\eta\in\{10^{-4},5\times10^{-5}\};\quad \begin{pmatrix}E_{\rm lin}(t)\\ I_{\rm lin}(t)\end{pmatrix}=\exp\!\left[t\begin{pmatrix}-0.3&0.6\\0.3&-0.2\end{pmatrix}\right]\begin{pmatrix}\eta\\\eta\end{pmatrix} 閉鎖人口S+E+I+R=1、β=0.6、σ=0.3、γ=0.2。η=10⁻⁴/5×10⁻⁵に対し(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1−2η,η,η,0)、0≤t≤20。出生・死亡・外部流入はありません。 SEIR conservation and initial linearization \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-\beta SI,&\dot E&=\beta SI-\sigma E,\\\dot I&=\sigma E-\gamma I,&\dot R&=\gamma I.\end{aligned};\quad \beta=0.6,\quad\sigma=0.3,\quad\gamma=0.2,\quad(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1-2\eta,\eta,\eta,0);\quad S+E+I+R=1,\quad\eta\in\{10^{-4},5\times10^{-5}\};\quad \begin{pmatrix}E_{\rm lin}(t)\\ I_{\rm lin}(t)\end{pmatrix}=\exp\!\left[t\begin{pmatrix}-0.3&0.6\\0.3&-0.2\end{pmatrix}\right]\begin{pmatrix}\eta\\\eta\end{pmatrix} Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20.
